Hyderabad Police Warns Women of 'Rent Boyfriend' Cyber Fraud

Hyderabad Police Commissioner C.V. Anand has issued a warning to young women regarding 'rent boyfriend' offers circulating on social media. These offers are being used by cybercriminals to trap women, who then demand advance payments, security deposits, or booking fees. The police are advising caution against such online schemes.
